channel.title: Daylight GNU/Linux — news
channel.description: A Fluxbox desktop, Rust tools and a sunrise identity for your 64-bit Raspberry Pi OS. Free software, yours to customise, installed with APT.

item.title: RC4: Shardturn and refreshed interfaces
item.description: Shardturn joins the optional games. The other games and tools gain a shared illustrated native interface, with application search, day/night settings, local scores and tournaments. Update with daylight update. The live ISO remains at 5.0.0-rc.2. Telemetry remains disabled by default.

item.title: Full installation and Debian 13 desktop fixes
item.description: APT revision 5.0.0~rc2-5 fixes the Games menu, Fluxbox window movement and resizing, and hides Conky temperature output when no sensor is available. Update: sudo daylight update.

item.title: Daylight V4’s Conky monitor and six illustrated games return
item.description: APT revision 5.0.0~rc2-4 brings together the desktop, game and text-to-speech updates for ARM64 and AMD64. To update, run sudo daylight update.

item.title: Raspberry Pi takes the lead
item.description: A Raspberry Pi pathway, complete mobile menu and new guides to discover and contribute.

item.title: Daylight GNU/Linux 5.0.0-rc.2
item.description: Release candidate: review the validation record before installing on an important machine.
